pricing_faq_q1: Puas yog tus nqi mus ntsib lossis ib lub rooj zaum ntawm cov neeg ua haujlwm?
pricing_faq_a1: Cov qib luam tawm yog ib pawg tsev kho mob nrog tsev kho mob thiab lub rooj zaum. Huab thiab On-premise share Starter, Lag luam, Nplai, thiab Platform. On-premise daim ntawv teev npe txhua hli yog Huab + $ 150. Tsis yog hom twg siv lub ntsuas ntsuas ib zaug uas nce rau hnub tsis khoom.
pricing_faq_q2: Vim li cas txhua xyoo txuag 20%?
pricing_faq_a2: Kev them nqi txhua xyoo hauv ib xyoo kwv yees ntawm Medora. Loomline-style tsev kho mob SaaS feem ntau txo cov phiaj xwm txhua xyoo txog 15 txog 20%. Medora siv 20% tawm ntawm daim ntawv teev npe txhua hli thaum koj them txhua xyoo, rau huab thiab On-premise (tom qab + $ 150 On-premise premium).
pricing_faq_q3: Puas yog cov khoom muag thiab cov chaw kho mob suav nrog?
pricing_faq_a3: Starter suav nrog cov ntawv sau npe tseem ceeb, mus ntsib, thiab chaw kho mob ua haujlwm nrog cov khoom muag yooj yim. Kev lag luam thiab saum toj no qhib tag nrho cov khoom lag luam ua haujlwm, kev txiav txim tshuaj txuas nrog rau cov khoom lag luam, thiab kev txhim kho kev tswj hwm zoo dua. Nug thaum koj xav tau kev tswj hwm add-ons.
pricing_faq_q4: Ntiaj teb no vs Myanmar nqi?
pricing_faq_a4: Siv lub lag luam toggle saum cov phiaj xwm. Ntiaj teb no qhia txog USD xwb. Myanmar qhia MMK ntawm 1 USD = 5000 MMK (nrog USD ua kab thib ob). Lub sijhawm them nqi thiab hom kev pabcuam yog cais los ntawm kev ua lag luam.
pricing_faq_a5: Huab yog tuav Medora: ntau lub tsev kho mob SaaS, tswj kev hloov tshiab, thiab pib sai dua. On-premise siv tib tiers, ntsia koj infrastructure thaum koj xav tau kev tswj los yog nyob rau hauv. Infra yog koj li; Cov npe txhua hli yog Huab + $ 150 rau lub luag haujlwm ntawd.
